name: clerk_list_users
description: List all users in the Clerk application with optional filtering by email or username

name: clerk_get_user
description: Get a specific user from Clerk by their user ID

name: clerk_create_user
description: Create a new user in Clerk with email, password, name, and metadata

name: clerk_update_user
description: Update a Clerk user's name, username, or metadata

name: clerk_delete_user
description: Delete a user from Clerk

name: clerk_ban_user
description: Ban a Clerk user to prevent them from signing in

name: clerk_unban_user
description: Unban a previously banned Clerk user

name: clerk_get_user_count
description: Get the total number of users in the Clerk application

name: clerk_list_user_sessions
description: List active sessions for a specific Clerk user

name: clerk_revoke_user_sessions
description: Revoke all active sessions for a Clerk user — forces sign-out on all devices

name: clerk_set_user_password
description: Set or reset a user's password in Clerk

name: clerk_get_user_oauth_access_tokens
description: Get a user's OAuth access tokens for a connected provider (github, google, etc.)

name: clerk_list_organizations
description: List all organizations in the Clerk application. Critical for multi-tenant YardSync/Cortiware.

name: clerk_get_organization
description: Get details about a specific Clerk organization

name: clerk_create_organization
description: Create a new organization in Clerk for a new tenant/customer

name: clerk_update_organization
description: Update a Clerk organization's name, metadata, or membership limits

name: clerk_delete_organization
description: Delete a Clerk organization and all its memberships

name: clerk_list_organization_memberships
description: List all members of a Clerk organization with their roles

name: clerk_add_organization_member
description: Add a user to a Clerk organization with a specific role

name: clerk_update_organization_member_role
description: Change a user's role within a Clerk organization

name: clerk_remove_organization_member
description: Remove a user from a Clerk organization

name: clerk_list_organization_invitations
description: List pending invitations to a Clerk organization

name: clerk_create_organization_invitation
description: Invite a user to join a Clerk organization by email

name: clerk_revoke_organization_invitation
description: Cancel a pending Clerk organization invitation

name: clerk_list_sessions
description: List active user sessions in the Clerk application

name: clerk_get_session
description: Get details about a specific Clerk session

name: clerk_revoke_session
description: Revoke a specific Clerk session — signs out that particular session

name: clerk_list_jwt_templates
description: List all JWT templates configured in the Clerk application

name: clerk_get_jwt_template
description: Get a specific JWT template from Clerk

name: clerk_get_instance
description: Get the Clerk application instance settings
